  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The identifier scan in `_heal_regression_budget_only` checks every unfenced line outside the Files section, including the required Decisions, Security considerations, Risks and Testing sections. Any UPPER_SNAKE identifier there that is not a knob or a context token (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_PAT, GITHUB_OUTPUT, OPENROUTER_API_KEY) makes the function return False ("not budget-only").
  WHY: A timeout-only plan with a routine security note naming GITHUB_TOKEN gets decision=approve with regression_named or not_a_regression, so the budget_only_plan hold fails open on the incident shape. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:570-572 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The identifier scan in `_heal_regression_budget_only` checks every line outside the Files section, including the required Security/Risks/Decisions sections, so mentioning GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_PAT or GITHUB_OUTPUT disqualifies the plan from being held as budget_only_plan.
  WHY: A PHASE_TIMEOUT-only plan with a routine security note naming GITHUB_TOKEN is auto-approved and bypasses the hold. This is likely the same root cause as the 593-600 entry, but it was not merged because the cited line ranges do not overlap.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:582-586 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The files loop in `_heal_regression_budget_only` returns False as soon as any "## Files likely to change" bullet does not match HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE. Plans routinely list the tests/** and changelog.d/*.md paths that heal scope always grants (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4181), so those plans are never classed as budget-only.
  WHY: A PHASE_TIMEOUT-only plan that also lists its changelog fragment or contract test is auto-approved as regression_named or not_a_regression, even with "not a regression: load grew", so the hold misses the incident shape. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:535-573 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_regression_budget_only` returns False if the Files section contains any file other than the failing workflow, even an always-granted changelog fragment or contract test.
  WHY: A timeout-only plan that includes a changelog fragment or test is auto-approved as regression_named or not_a_regression and is not held. This is likely the same root cause as the 582-586 entry, but it was not merged because the cited line ranges are more than 5 lines apart.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:489-494 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_regression_target_ok` accepts directory tokens as named regression targets: HEAL_RG_PATH_RE at line 437 allows a trailing "/" and the final clause accepts any token containing "/", so `HEAL_REGRESSION: scripts/` validates as form=named.
  WHY: A line that names neither a file nor a commit is approved as regression_named and bypasses the regression_line_missing hold. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, the other four rated it MAJOR, and the highest is used.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:489-494 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The extension check `re.search(r"\.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", token)` in `_heal_regression_target_ok` accepts prose tokens with a dotted alphanumeric suffix, such as `2.5x`, `v1.2`, `0.1` and `p90=2.1s`, as file paths.
  WHY: `HEAL_REGRESSION: runs are 2.5x slower since v1.2` is approved as regression_named without naming a file or commit. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, the other three rated it MAJOR, and the highest is used.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:520 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_regression_line` tests HEAL_RG_NOT_RE before the "|" template check, so the literal placeholder "HEAL_REGRESSION: not a regression: <reason>" is accepted as not_regression because "<reason>" is non-empty.
  WHY: The copied template placeholder returns decision=approve, so the regression_line_missing hold passes without a real reason.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3004,3095-3104 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The regression hold reuses `heal_counterfactual_plan_hold`, whose Telegram message hardcodes "counterfactual", so a regression hold is announced as "counterfactual REGRESSION (budget_only_plan)". The step summary at line 3100 also asserts a regression even when the reason is heal_regression_check_unavailable.
  WHY: Operators see alerts naming a gate that did not fire, and summaries asserting a regression the check never established, so triage is misrouted. The hold comment itself is labelled correctly.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:3082 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The shell switch check strips all interior whitespace (`tr -d '[:space:]'`), while `normalize_heal_trend_flag` (scripts/partial_delivery.py:440-442) only trims the ends with `.strip().lower()`.
  WHY: A value such as `WORKFLOW_HEAL_TREND_ENABLED="tr ue"` enables the shell gate, but the parser reports gate_disabled and approves, with no warning or mismatch signal, so the hold is silently disabled.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only (bullet extraction) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: For a Files bullet without backticks, `files.append((ticked.group(1) if ticked else bullet.group(1).split()[0]).strip())` records only the first token, e.g. `see`, so HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE fails and the function returns False.
  WHY: A prose-style Files bullet escapes the budget-only hold and the plan is approved. This is latent because the prompt asks for backticked paths.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, lines 598-600 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The identifier scan covers every unfenced line outside the first Files section and the HEAL_RG_SKIP_PREFIXES lines. That includes the required "## Decisions", "## Security considerations", "Risks and edge cases" and "Testing considerations" sections (prompts/mode-plan.txt lines 43-48). One UPPER_SNAKE token such as GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_PAT or GITHUB_OUTPUT returns False. HEAL_RG_CONTEXT_TOKENS whitelists only the seven gate/switch names.
  WHY: The incident-shape plan (workflow-only Files section, PHASE_TIMEOUT raise, valid HEAL_REGRESSION line, Security bullet naming GITHUB_TOKEN) gets decision=approve and is auto-approved at plan.yml lines 3093-3106, so the budget_only_plan hold fails open. Suggested fix: skip lines under those headings, or treat identifiers there as context.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, lines 582-585 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every Files bullet must be the failing workflow. Heal scope always grants tests/** and changelog.d/*.md (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py line 4181), so a PHASE_TIMEOUT-only plan that also lists `changelog.d/x.md` or `tests/test_ci_timeout.py` returns False.
  WHY: The plan is auto-approved even with "HEAL_REGRESSION: not a regression: load grew", which the issue says must not lift this hold. Suggested fix: ignore tests/**, changelog.d/*.md and agents.d/*.md bullets while still requiring one failing-workflow path.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_target_ok, lines 437 and 489-494; _heal_regression_line line 520 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The named form accepts directories (e.g. "HEAL_REGRESSION: scripts/") and dotted alphanumeric suffixes (e.g. "2.5x", "v1.2"). The literal placeholder "not a regression: <reason>" is accepted as not_regression.
  WHY: Each returns decision=approve without naming a file or commit, so the regression_line_missing hold passes. Suggested fix: reject a trailing "/", use r"\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$", and treat a reason that is only "<...>" as empty.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:Line 3004 (heal_counterfactual_plan_hold tg_send_msg); hold block lines 3095-3103; step summary line 3100 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Every regression hold sends the Telegram alert "counterfactual REGRESSION (budget_only_plan)". The summary asserts a regression even when the reason is heal_regression_check_unavailable.
  WHY: Alerts and summaries name a gate that did not fire, which misroutes triage. Suggested fix: choose the gate word from heal_cf_result=REGRESSION and add a summary branch for unavailable.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items), HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  (a) .github/workflows/plan.yml line 3082: the `tr -d '[:space:]'` shell check and normalize_heal_trend_flag (scripts/partial_delivery.py line 440) normalize differently, so "tr ue" enables the shell gate while the parser reports gate_disabled. Fix: use the line-3034 sed end-trim (1 line).
  (b) scripts/partial_delivery.py _heal_regression_target_ok line 494: add "if token.endswith('/'): return False" and use the regex r"\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$" (2 lines).
- Missing-context notes (4 related items):
  (a) CI check collection timed out (failed_count 0), so the absence of CI failures is not confirmed.
  (b) The pre-push gate attributes failures in tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_ai_labels*.py, tests/test_no_session_automation.py, tests/test_operator_step_issue.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py and tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py to this change, but none maps to a hunk. Re-run them on the PR head.
  (c) The `wc -c` check on plan.yml was not verified.
  (d) The parser regexes match scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py lines 6306-6315 and 6624-6673. heal_cf_repro_required is unaffected (plan.yml line 3269).
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All deliverables are present, and the poller stall-recovery path is out of scope and documented as a known gap.
